levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Steps are out of order, missing a clear ending, or combine two or more actions into a single step.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Four to six ordered, single-action steps run from a gathering step to a finishing step.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Proficient, and the learner explains why the step order matters for this specific job.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The materials list is missing an item that a step on the plan actually needs.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every item needed by the step list appears on the materials list.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Proficient, and each material is matched to the specific step that uses it.

lookFors: The materials list only includes items already available in the learner's own home.
No single step on the list combines two separate actions into one line.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
